[P2] Preserve observed replacement-worker correlation

The accepted `replace-worker` recovery policy requires the recovery attempt's `replacesWorkerId`, but this constructor never retains that field from source observations. The `worker_identity` callback supplies only the current worker ID. Thus the shared normalizer always rejects a conforming replacement-worker recovery, even when the SDK records the original worker correlation. Populate `replacesWorkerId` from explicit source evidence and add a normalization test for this supported policy.
